findings.title: Unused import: FORBIDDEN_CLI_NAMES in auditor_router.py
findings.body: auditor_router.py imported FORBIDDEN_CLI_NAMES but never used it directly; enforcement is correctly delegated to AuditRoute.__post_init__. Removed from import line.

findings.title: Missing encoding in path.read_text()
findings.body: load_route_from_clink_config called path.read_text() without encoding='utf-8', risking misreads on non-UTF-8 locales. Fixed by adding explicit encoding parameter.

findings.title: No role validation against clink config roles block
findings.body: load_route_from_clink_config did not verify the requested role exists in the config's roles block. Added KeyError with helpful message listing available roles. Updated test fixture and added test_load_route_raises_when_role_not_in_config.

findings.title: Schema allows 'codex' as command value
findings.body: audit_route.schema.json blocked codex/codex-audit in cli_name but not in command. Added not:{enum:[codex]} constraint to command property.
